lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repeating grid-like array of circular high-luminance local maxima is present across the lateral flank, with spacing increasing slightly towards the posterior and ventral regions.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, with primary high-luminance blobs positioned at the intersections of these vertical bands and faint longitudinal rows.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features are visible on the lateral flank, defined by a sharp high-to-low vertical luminance gradient characteristic of physical ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs; approximately four distinct spots are visible within the boundary of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast ovoid mark with a white center and black perimeter is visible on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the second visible carina and ventral to the dorsal fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least three slender, high-luminance biological entities attached to or swimming adjacent to the ventral and pectoral regions.
